followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by capability metrics, not the models' self-reported preferences (which the documentation explicitly notes are dissociated from output quality). This is a light creative-generation task, and Willet leads on Creative Generation (82.7 vs 78.8) and Arena-Hard (83.2 vs 81.4). Note: Willet self-reports *disliking* open-ended generative work (win-rate 35), but since preference doesn't track quality, I ignored that and routed on the eval scores where Willet is marginally better.
